title: v3 states no owning service and no owning schema for any of the 14 data products
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership (columns A to K) and Ownership split (columns A to F)
description: All 14 data product rows name a business owner, a data steward, a system of record and a tier, but no row says which of the 19 services owns the data or which rwb_<name> schema holds it. v3 is written for one recovery schema and one Workbench application owner, so the owner service is derived in v4 from the Ownership Map rather than read from the source.
evidence: The Ownership header is 11 columns (ID to Tier) with no owner-service and no schema column; Ownership split rows 5 to 8 name one Owner each (ACE team, Workbench data steward) and rows 7 and 8 read 'the recovery module'; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 635 (ACE schemas, 30 recovery.v_ace_* views, 19 rwb_* schemas, one login each) and line 2147 (19 Recovery schemas rwb_<service>); Ownership Map sheet Tables (Table, Owner, Schema, 93 rows).
proposed: Add 'Owning service (D-RCV-60)', 'Owning schema (D-RCV-60)' and 'Basis (D-RCV-60)' at the end of the Ownership and Ownership split sheets, one owner per data product from the Ownership Map, and keep columns A to K unchanged.

title: DP04 Treatment and offers has three owners after the realignment
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP04 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP04 covers restructures, settlements, deeds in lieu, buy-backs and guarantee claims. The live treatment record is rwb_treatment (S2), the live guarantee claim is rwb_guarantee (S3), and the dated DP04 copies dp_treatment and dp_guarantee_claim are rwb_source_data (P1). One owning service is recorded in v4 (S2) and the other two are named in the basis cell.
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables rows treatment (S2), guarantee_claim (S3), dp_treatment (P1) and dp_guarantee_claim (P1) with ruling ASM-A6-tables-14; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2893 (S2 owns treatments, contracts, settlement and deed-in-lieu agreements) and line 2894 (S3 owns TCG and insurance claims).
area: Data / ownership of treatment and guarantee claims
proposed: Keep DP04 whole and record S2 as the owner of the live record, with S3 and P1 named in the basis cell; split DP04 in two at the next LDM revision if the programme wants one owner per data product with no note.

title: DP06 Collateral and assets mixes ACE data, S5 asset records and a P1 extension table
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP06 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP06 covers collateral, appraisals, assets held after repossession, listings and sale results. The ACE-side collateral, asset and valuation records stay ACE data read through rwb-source-data (P1); the Workbench asset lifecycle (asset_sale, listing) is rwb_asset (S5); the Workbench flag table valuation_ext is rwb_source_data (P1). v4 records S5 as the owner of the Workbench data set and names the other two in the basis cell.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2896 (S5 owns assets taken on, holding, floor price, listings and auction rounds); Ownership Map sheet Tables rows asset_sale (S5), listing (S5) and valuation_ext (P1) with ruling ASM-A6-tables-15; v3 DP06 system of record 'ACE (collateral, asset, valuation, npa_asset and npa_sale)'.
area: Data / ownership of collateral and assets
proposed: Record S5 for the Workbench asset data set; ACE collateral and valuation stay a P1 read and valuation_ext stays P1, as the basis cell states.

title: DP07 Legal events and cases mixes ACE court records, S4 legal actions and P6 notices
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP07 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP07 covers notices and proof of delivery, lawsuits, court case numbers, hearings, judgments and enforcement. The ACE records (lawsuit, hearing, pod_receipt) are read through P1, the Workbench legal actions and hearings are rwb_litigation (S4) and the notice is rwb_comms (P6). v4 records S4 as the owner of the Workbench legal data set.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2895 (S4 owns legal actions, hearings, judgments, enforcement and the LED auction ladder) and line 2889 (P6 owns notices, templates, merge fields and proof of delivery); Ownership Map sheet Tables rows legal_action (S4), hearing (S4) and notice (P6); v3 DP07 system of record 'ACE (lawsuit, hearing and pod_receipt) and the Workbench for notices and instructions'.
proposed: Record S4 for the legal data set; the ACE court records stay a P1 read and the notice and proof of delivery stay P6.

title: DP11 Scores and route economics has no table row in the Ownership Map
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP11 (columns G and L to N) and Ownership split row 8
description: DP11 rests on an ACE score table (collins_score) read through P1 for Tier 2 and on Workbench route economics for Tier 4. The Ownership Map sheet Tables has 93 rows and none sits in schema rwb_valuation, so the owner of route economics cannot be derived from the table map; v4 takes it from Architecture v5 slide 41 (S1 owns valuations, the D6 route decision and the route agent output).
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables: no rwb_valuation row, and 88 Tier 4 tables spread over 18 services plus the platform library, S1 among the missing; Ownership Map sheet Services row S1 rwb-valuation; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2892; Ownership Map sheet Rulings rows POST /assets/{assetId}/valuations and POST /assets/{assetKey}/valuations (ASM-A6-api-6) give the valuation paths to S1.
area: Data / ownership of scores and route economics
proposed: Record S1 as the owner and let the S1 DB story create the rwb_valuation tables (valuation, route decision, route agent output); add the rows to the Ownership Map at its next revision.

title: DP13 Money and closure mixes P8 proceeds, S7 write-off and ACE payment and GL data
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP13 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP13 covers payments and proceeds matched to the case, write-off postings and recovery after charge-off. proceeds is rwb_payment (P8), write_off is rwb_writeoff (S7) and the ACE payment and gl_write_off records are read through P1. v4 records P8 as the owner of the matching data set.
evidence: Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2890 (P8 owns payment and proceeds matching, fees, bookings and posting files) and line 2898 (S7 owns eligibility, committee, posting and recovery after charge-off); Ownership Map sheet Tables rows proceeds (P8) and write_off (S7); v3 DP13 system of record 'ACE (payment and gl_write_off) and the Workbench for matching'.
area: Data / ownership of money and closure
proposed: Record P8 for the proceeds and matching data set; write_off stays S7 and the ACE payment and GL records stay a P1 read.

title: DP05 Contact and promises splits into a P1 ledger, P6 letters and a P3 case timeline
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP05 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP05 covers every contact, letter, promise and hand-over on the case, including the EFS collections history. The interaction ledger and EFS ledger are rwb_source_data (P1, R-PREC default ruling), the notice and its template are rwb_comms (P6) and the case timeline is a projection in rwb_case (P3). v4 records P1 as the owner of the ledger.
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables rows interaction (P1), efs_ledger_outcome (P1), notice (P6), template (P6) and merge_field (P6); Ownership Map sheet Rulings rows interaction and efs_ledger_outcome (ASM-A6-tables-1); Template and Rules R3 default ruling (interaction ledger); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2889.
proposed: Record P1 for the interaction ledger; notice content and delivery stay P6 and the case timeline stays a P3 read through the P1 contract.

title: DP14 Reference data splits into P3 parameters and lists, P4 roles and DoA, and P6 templates
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership, row DP14 (columns F, G and L to N)
description: DP14 covers rules, approval limits, lists of values, roles, permissions and letter templates. Parameters, lists of values and reference versions are rwb_case (P3) under the R-PREC default ruling, roles, permissions, masking rules and the DoA table are rwb_access (P4) and templates and merge fields are rwb_comms (P6). v4 records P3 as the owner of the parameters and reference data.
evidence: Ownership Map sheet Tables rows lov_value, reference_row, reference_version, parameter_catalog and parameter_value (P3); role, permission, masking_rule and delegation_limit (P4); template and merge_field (P6); Ownership Map sheet Rulings rows lov_value (ASM-A6-tables-5) and delegation_limit (ASM-A6-tables-4); Template and Rules R3 default ruling (parameters and reference data E1-042 and E1-043 to P3).
proposed: Record P3 for parameters and reference data, as the default ruling says; roles and DoA stay P4 and templates stay P6.

title: The 88 Workbench tables of Tier 4 cannot be reconciled with the 93 rows of the Ownership Map from v3 alone
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership split, row 4 (column B) and row 8 (columns G to I)
description: Ownership split row 4 states 88 Workbench tables. The Ownership Map lists 93 tables: 4 are the Tier 3 extension tables (party_ext, contact_point_ext, account_ext, valuation_ext) and lake_copy_watermark is a P1 legacy table with no target under DP-17, which leaves exactly 88. v3 does not say which 88, so a reader cannot reconcile the two counts without the map.
evidence: Ownership split row 8 '88 Workbench tables'; Ownership Map sheet Tables 93 rows; Ownership Map sheet Rulings row lake_copy_watermark (P1, dropped, ASM-A6-tables-13); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-17 (no data lake) and Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 37 reference (line 1451, the data lake is removed).
proposed: Keep the count of 88 and add the reconciliation in the appended basis cell: 93 rows, 4 extension tables, 1 legacy table with no target, 88 Tier 4 tables over 19 owners.

title: Roles, Change process and Quality measures still describe one Workbench owner, one backlog and one check set
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Roles rows 6 to 8; Change process step 4; Quality measures rows 5, 8 and 10
description: The Roles sheet names one Workbench data steward and one Workbench application owner for Tier 3 and Tier 4, the Change process sends every Tier 3 and Tier 4 change to one Workbench backlog, and the Quality measures check Tier 3 and 4 with one set of Workbench rules. After the realignment there are 19 owners, each with its own schema, backlog, Flyway sequence and build pipeline.
evidence: Roles rows 6, 7 and 8; Change process step 4 ('a Tier 3 or Tier 4 change goes to the Workbench backlog'); Quality measures rows 5, 8 and 10 ('Workbench data quality rules'); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2149 (one login per schema, no grant on any other, no cross-schema joins) and line 2903.
proposed: Add one role row (service data steward), one change-process step (owner service) and one quality measure (schema isolation) in v4; keep the v3 rows unchanged.

title: Six Ownership rows name 'Application owner (DL02)' and two Ownership split rows name 'the recovery module'
source: 06 Data/Recovery Workbench Data Ownership and Stewardship v3.xlsx
section: Ownership column G (six rows); Ownership split column F (rows 7 and 8)
description: Six data product rows name 'Application owner (DL02)' as the system of record owner and two Ownership split rows read 'Read and write by the recovery module'. The monolith module and the single recovery schema are replaced by 19 services and 19 rwb_<name> schemas, so the wording names an owner that no longer exists. v4 keeps the six Ownership cells, changes the two 'Workbench access' cells and appends the owning service column.
evidence: Ownership column G rows DP03, DP08, DP09, DP10, DP12 and DP14 read 'Application owner (DL02)'; Ownership split rows 7 and 8 column F read 'Read and write by the recovery module'; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 line 2079 (schema recovery holds only the 30 read-only v_ace_* views) and line 2147 (19 Recovery schemas rwb_<service>).
proposed: Read 'Application owner (DL02)' as the owning service named in the appended column and change the two 'Workbench access' cells to the owning service and its schema; replace the DL02 wording at the next document revision.
